title_zh: 核算住宿交通估价并约定索取费用明细

scenario.goal_zh: 把交通加入两处住宿估价，确认可能节省约三十英镑并决定先索取完整报价再预订

context_zh: 朋友为虚构周末行程比较宣传单价格，所有金额仅用于对话练习。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: The rural resort is two hundred and forty pounds for two nights. The hotel in town is three hundred and thirty.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: The resort has no station pickup. A return taxi would be roughly sixty pounds, according to this estimate.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: So the total would be about three hundred, not two hundred and forty.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: Right. The hotel includes its station shuttle, so the resort would offer a saving of only about thirty pounds.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: And we have not checked whether breakfast costs extra at the resort.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: Shall we ask for a full price, including breakfast, before booking either one?

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Yes. I'll ask for that breakdown. Thirty pounds is only a possible difference until we know all the charges.
